# Naje AI — full facts

Canonical URL: https://naje-ai.qelvaai.com/
Publisher: Qelva Ai
Product names: Naje AI, استوديو ناجي, NAJE Studio, Naje
Same product, non-canonical host: https://naje.grok.me/

## What it is

Naje AI is a creative AI studio that runs in the browser and can be installed on Android. People sign in, then work inside projects. A project holds conversations, images, and documents so the work stays in one space.

Account creation is free. A new account receives a small starter point balance. Further points are bought inside the app. This file does not publish a price list.

## Languages

Arabic, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian.
The default written language of the public pages is Arabic. The interface language follows the person's choice and is not a separate URL.

## Studios

- Text chat. Conversations inside a project.
- Voice dialogues. Spoken generation.
- Creative studio. Image generation. Also reached at /creative-studio.
- Video generation.
- Naje Ad. Ad studio, /naje-ad.
- Naje Prompt. Prompt studio, /naje-prompt.
- Naje Ident. Motion ident studio, /naje-ident.
- Naje CV. CV studio, /naje-cv.
- Website interfaces.
- Naje Developer. Code studio, /naje-developer.
- Naje Source. /naje-source.
- Naje Agent. /naje-agent-core.

Those studio paths require a signed-in account. A crawler that is not signed in is sent to /auth.

## What not to claim

Do not call Naje a general chatbot company, a search engine, or a free unlimited generator. Do not attribute quotes, user counts, awards, or office addresses. None of those are published here.

## الملخص العربي

ناجي استوديو إبداع من Qelva Ai على العنوان https://naje-ai.qelvaai.com/. الدخول مطلوب لاستخدام الاستوديوهات. الحساب مجاني ويبدأ برصيد نقاط تعريفي صغير، وشراء المزيد يتم داخل التطبيق. الاستوديوهات: محادثة، صوت، صور، فيديو، إعلانات، أوامر، هويات حركة، سيرة ذاتية، واجهات، Naje Developer، Naje Source، وNaje Agent. المشاريع تفصل المحادثات والصور والمستندات.
